title: samesight lint --format json
description: One document per run on stdout, for exits 0, 1 and 2. Fields may be added in a later version 1; a field's meaning does not change without a new version.

$schema.description: This schema, for the samesight version that wrote the document.

files.description: The sync configs read, as named or as found; empty when lint could not run.

rlsChecked.description: Whether migrations were read, so rls-off and rls-open ran.

exitCode.description: 0 clean or warnings only, 1 an error-level finding, 2 a file could not be read or lint could not run.

error.description: Why lint could not run (no sync config, a bad --migrations directory, an unknown --allow rule, a bad flag); only then.

rule.description: The rule's id; a later version may add rules.

file.description: The sync config the finding is about.

subjects.description: The stream or bucket, table, policy or column it is about: what --allow <rule>:<name> matches.
